test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies a threshold filtering rule based on a numerical temperature limit ('do not exceed the overtemperature limits'). Per the selection guidance, numeric ranges or thresholds trigger Equivalence Partitioning (to partition inputs into temperatures <= limit which are output, and > limit which are excluded) and Boundary Value Analysis (to test exact boundary values at, just below, and just above the overtemperature threshold).
